observations.says: on Friday morning, the strongroom door was opened with its key, and not forced
from ten o'clock on Thursday night until seven o'clock on Friday morning, Josiah Kemp had the keys of the bank and of the strongroom
from Wednesday until seven o'clock on Friday morning, Tobias Finch was in the lock-up at Cross Street
from ten o'clock on Thursday night until seven o'clock on Friday morning, Josiah Kemp was at Bly's Bank
